default_inbound_policy.title: Default Inbound Policy
default_inbound_policy.description: The default policy applied to inbound traffic when no explicit rule matches. Should be DROP or REJECT to enforce deny-all baseline.

default_outbound_policy.title: Default Outbound Policy
default_outbound_policy.description: The default policy applied to outbound traffic when no explicit rule matches. Should be DROP or REJECT; ACCEPT allows all unchecked egress.

default_forward_policy.title: Default Forward Policy
default_forward_policy.description: The default policy applied to forwarded traffic when no explicit rule matches. Should be DROP or REJECT to prevent unauthorized transit traffic.

explicit_deny_all_rule_present.title: Explicit Deny-All Rule Present
explicit_deny_all_rule_present.description: Whether an explicit deny-all rule exists at the end of each chain to catch unmatched traffic, serving as a safety net even if the default policy is permissive.

management_interface_network_scope.title: Management Interface Network Scope
management_interface_network_scope.description: Describes which network segments can reach the firewall's management interface. Indicates whether access is restricted to a dedicated out-of-band management network, a specific IP allowlist, a broad internal network, or is publicly reachable.

management_source_ip_allowlist_configure.title: Management Source IP Allowlist Configured
management_source_ip_allowlist_configure.description: Whether a specific source IP or subnet allowlist is enforced for management interface access, preventing access from arbitrary addresses.

management_interface_bound_to_dedicated_.title: Management Interface Bound to Dedicated Physical/Logical Interface
management_interface_bound_to_dedicated_.description: Whether the management service is bound exclusively to a dedicated out-of-band management interface rather than to a data-plane or any-interface binding.

default_credentials_changed.title: Default Credentials Changed
default_credentials_changed.description: Indicates whether all factory-default usernames and passwords for administrative accounts have been changed from their out-of-box values.

password_complexity_policy_enforced.title: Password Complexity Policy Enforced
password_complexity_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether the firewall enforces a password complexity policy (minimum length, character classes, expiration) for administrative accounts.

admin_account_lockout_enabled.title: Administrative Account Lockout Enabled
admin_account_lockout_enabled.description: Indicates whether the management plane enforces account lockout or rate-limiting after a configurable number of consecutive failed login attempts, mitigating brute-force attacks.

global_logging_enabled.title: Global Logging Enabled
global_logging_enabled.description: Indicates whether logging is enabled at the global/system level on the firewall. When disabled, no traffic events are recorded regardless of per-rule settings.

rules_without_logging_count.title: Number of Rules Without Logging Enabled
rules_without_logging_count.description: The count of firewall rules (particularly ACCEPT/ALLOW rules) that do not have logging flags set, meaning matched traffic will not be recorded.

log_destination_configured.title: Log Destination Configured
log_destination_configured.description: Indicates whether a valid log destination (syslog server, SIEM, local file, or remote collector) is configured to receive firewall log events.

management_protocols_in_use.title: Management Protocols in Use
management_protocols_in_use.description: List of protocols actively enabled for management plane access (e.g., telnet, http, ssh, https). Used to detect cleartext protocol exposure and enumerate attack surface.

encrypted_management_enforced.title: Encrypted Management Protocol Enforced
encrypted_management_enforced.description: Whether the firewall enforces exclusive use of encrypted management protocols (SSH, HTTPS/TLS) and actively blocks or disables cleartext alternatives.

tls_minimum_version.title: Minimum TLS Version for Management
tls_minimum_version.description: The minimum TLS version required for HTTPS management sessions. 'none' indicates TLS is not configured or enforced.

firmware_version_current.title: Firmware/OS Version Is Current
firmware_version_current.description: Indicates whether the firewall firmware or OS is running the latest vendor-supported version with all critical patches applied. False when running a version with known unpatched CVEs.

auto_update_or_patch_compliance_enabled.title: Auto-Update or Scheduled Patch Compliance Enabled
auto_update_or_patch_compliance_enabled.description: Indicates whether automatic firmware/OS updates or a scheduled patch compliance policy is actively configured and enforced on the firewall.

days_since_last_patch.title: Days Since Last Patch Applied
days_since_last_patch.description: Number of days elapsed since the last firmware or OS patch was successfully applied to the firewall.

rule_audit_performed.title: Rule Base Audit Performed
rule_audit_performed.description: Indicates whether a periodic rule-base audit (for shadowing, redundancy, and conflicts) has been conducted within the required review interval.

shadowed_rules_detected.title: Shadowed Rules Detected
shadowed_rules_detected.description: Indicates whether any rules in the rule set are fully shadowed by a preceding broader rule, meaning traffic matching the shadowed rule will never reach it.

redundant_permit_rules_count.title: Redundant Permit Rules Count
redundant_permit_rules_count.description: Number of duplicate or redundant permit rules identified in the active rule base that match the same traffic as another permit rule and provide no additional specificity.

egress_policy_defined.title: Egress Policy Defined
egress_policy_defined.description: Indicates whether any outbound traffic filtering rules or policies are explicitly configured on the firewall.

default_egress_action.title: Default Egress Action
default_egress_action.description: The default action applied to outbound traffic when no specific egress rule matches — typically 'allow', 'deny', or 'drop'.

egress_rule_count.title: Egress Rule Count
egress_rule_count.description: The total number of explicit outbound filtering rules configured on the firewall (excluding default catch-all rules).

mfa_enabled.title: MFA Enabled on Admin Interface
mfa_enabled.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is required for administrative access to the firewall management plane.

admin_auth_method.title: Administrative Authentication Method
admin_auth_method.description: The authentication method configured for administrative access to the firewall management interface.

backup_encryption_enabled.title: Backup Encryption Enabled
backup_encryption_enabled.description: Whether configuration backups are encrypted at rest and in transit using a strong encryption algorithm (e.g., AES-256).

backup_integrity_signing_enabled.title: Backup Integrity Signing Enabled
backup_integrity_signing_enabled.description: Whether configuration backups are signed with a cryptographic signature (e.g., HMAC or digital signature) to detect tampering before restore.

backup_transfer_protocol.title: Backup Transfer Protocol
backup_transfer_protocol.description: The network protocol used to transfer backup files to a remote storage location.

log_forwarding_enabled.title: Log Forwarding Enabled
log_forwarding_enabled.description: Whether firewall logs are configured to be forwarded to a remote destination such as a SIEM or syslog server.

forwarding_destinations.title: Log Forwarding Destinations
forwarding_destinations.description: List of configured remote log forwarding destinations (e.g., syslog server IPs or SIEM endpoints).

local_only_log_storage.title: Local-Only Log Storage
local_only_log_storage.description: Whether firewall logs are stored exclusively on the local filesystem with no forwarding configured.

rbac_enabled.title: Role-Based Access Control Enabled
rbac_enabled.description: Indicates whether the firewall management interface enforces role-based access control, allowing differentiated roles such as read-only, rule-editor, and auditor instead of a single super-admin role.

admin_accounts_with_superadmin_role_coun.title: Number of Admin Accounts Assigned Super-Admin Role
admin_accounts_with_superadmin_role_coun.description: The total count of administrative accounts that have been assigned the full super-admin (unrestricted) role on the firewall management platform.

least_privilege_policy_enforced.title: Least Privilege Policy Enforced for Admin Accounts
least_privilege_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether a documented and enforced least-privilege policy exists that restricts administrative accounts to only the permissions necessary for their designated function.

stateful_inspection_enabled.title: Stateful Inspection Enabled
stateful_inspection_enabled.description: Indicates whether the firewall performs stateful packet inspection, tracking connection state and allowing only packets that match an established session or valid new connection.

invalid_state_packet_action.title: Invalid State Packet Action
invalid_state_packet_action.description: The action taken when packets arrive that do not match any tracked connection state (e.g., TCP packets without a preceding SYN, or mid-session packets with no session record).

asymmetric_routing_bypass_enabled.title: Asymmetric Routing Bypass Enabled
asymmetric_routing_bypass_enabled.description: Indicates whether an explicit bypass or exemption from stateful inspection has been configured to accommodate asymmetric routing paths, which disables connection state validation for affected traffic.

ha_peer_configured.title: High Availability Peer Configured
ha_peer_configured.description: Indicates whether a redundant HA peer or cluster member is configured for the firewall.

failover_mode.title: Failover Mode
failover_mode.description: The behavior of the firewall upon hardware or software failure — fail-open (traffic passes without inspection), fail-closed (traffic is dropped), or no failover mechanism configured.

inbound_icmp_unrestricted.title: Inbound ICMP Unrestricted from Untrusted Zones
inbound_icmp_unrestricted.description: Indicates whether ICMP traffic is permitted inbound from untrusted or external zones without source restriction or rate limiting.

inbound_snmp_unrestricted.title: Inbound SNMP Unrestricted from Untrusted Zones
inbound_snmp_unrestricted.description: Indicates whether SNMP (UDP/161, UDP/162) is permitted inbound from untrusted or external zones without source IP allowlisting or authentication enforcement at the firewall level.

diagnostic_protocols_exposed.title: Diagnostic Protocols Exposed from Untrusted Zones
diagnostic_protocols_exposed.description: List of diagnostic or management protocols (other than ICMP/SNMP) permitted inbound from untrusted zones without restriction, e.g. traceroute, NTP, CDP, LLDP, syslog inbound.
